content.short: TonStable is a decentralized over-collateralized stablecoin protocol built for the TON network.
content.description: TonStable is a DeFi protocol built around an over-collateralized stablecoin model on TON. TON App and Tongram listings describe it as infrastructure for native earning in the TON ecosystem and as a stablecoin protocol intended to support TON DeFi. The entry is kept focused on that public description without adding unsupported details about collateral types or yield levels. For TonStable, the TON value is the specific DeFi action it enables, from market access and routing to yield, liquidity, or position management.
